analysis:
At the chief ministers' meeting on the NCTC on 5 May 2012, Chidambaram said 21 terror modules had been neutralised in 2011 and up to March 2012, and that about half the cases had been solved jointly by central agencies and state police.

The figure is a government count. No public, case-level dataset listing the 21 modules was located, and the PIB release gives no further breakdown or definition of 'module' or 'neutralised'.

The claim is therefore recorded as unverifiable rather than true or false.
